channel.title: Moonbrim Bedtime Stories
channel.description: Gentle, cinematic bedtime stories for little dreamers — the audio companion to the Moonbrim video series. New episodes as each story premieres on YouTube.
channel.itunes:author: Moonbrim

item.title: Lumen and the Kind Jar — a Bedtime Story About Kindness ✨
item.description:
Lumen the tiny firefly is caught by gentle hands on a meteor night and kept safe in a jar where her warm gold lantern slowly grows quiet. This bedtime story about kindness paints the meadow outside the window and the moment the lid opens with a golden light returning to the night.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Owl Who Kept Falling Asleep 🦉 A Forest Bedtime Story
item.description:
Sol is a tiny owlet who keeps yawning through moonlit lessons but secretly loves the sunrise. This kids morning story follows her awkward school blunders and the dawn when her early wakefulness warns the forest. Soft, cinematic animation shows how being different can become a quiet kind of courage.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: Poppy and the New Egg 🦆 A Big Sister Bedtime Story
item.description:
Poppy had mama all to herself until an egg arrived and the nest felt smaller. This Poppy kids story follows the night the egg tumbles toward the dark pond and Poppy races to catch and warm it like mama through the storm. A gentle tale for any child about to become a big brother or sister.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Whale Who Sang Too Deep 🐳 An Ocean Bedtime Story
item.description:
Wren is a small humpback calf with a white star on her tail who sings too deep for the bright pod to hear. This whale bedtime story for kids follows her deep lullaby as it rolls into a dark canyon — and the voice that finally answers. A gentle ocean tale about a song that travels where bright songs cannot.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Elephant Who Was Afraid of Small Things 🐘 Elephant Bedtime Story for Kids
item.description:
Meet Juno, a round baby elephant who can carry logs but jumps at beetles; when a cricket sings beneath her feet she later discovers a hidden spring that saves the herd. This gentle bedtime story about elephant moments brings soft savanna sounds and cozy visuals for little ones.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Sock Who Lost His Twin 🧦 — a kids story about socks
item.description:
Blue, a small sky-blue striped sock, searches the washer and the lost-and-found box for his missing twin and finds a new, mismatched friend instead. This gentle kids story about socks follows a tiny adventure through the laundry room and the warm corners of a family home.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Thunder Who Was Too Loud ⛈️ A Stormy Night Bedtime Story
item.description:
When Boom whispered hello, every window slammed shut. Boom is a small thundercloud who keeps his big voice in — until the night the river rose and the sleeping valley needed the loudest lullaby in the world. This gentle kids story about thunder comforts little ones who have ever been told they are too much.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Little Root Who Saved the Garden 🌱 A Bedtime Story for Kids About Quiet Courage
item.description:
Root, a pale-gold seedling root, digs unseen through stones and dark soil until she finds the hidden water that saves her twin sprout. A gentle bedtime story for kids about unnoticed work, perseverance, and quiet courage. For every little one whose effort goes unseen.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Moth Who Was Afraid of the Dark 🦋 A Moonlight Bedtime Story
item.description:
Plume was born at noon and loved the light, until one night she got lost between the lamps and forgot how to fly. A silver moonbeam opens above the sleeping hills and her wings drink the moonlight; she learns the dark is made of soft lights. A tender addition to kids moth stories, this is for every little one who sleeps with the light on.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Snail Who Lit the Lighthouse 🐌 A Stormy Night Bedtime Story
item.description:
Pearl the snail climbs the wet stones of an old lighthouse on the night the great light dies. This gentle bedtime story about snails follows her as her faint, glistening trail turns into a silver beacon that guides three small boats home. For every child who ever felt too small and too slow.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Backpack Who Was Scared of School 🎒 First Day Bedtime Story
item.description:
The night before the first day of school, Mila finds her brand new backpack hiding under the bed — trembling. This gentle first-day tale turns the little pack into a kids story bag of quiet courage as Mila and the backpack practice bravery and walk into school together.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories

item.title: The Little Cloud Who Couldn't Rain ☁️ — a bedtime story about clouds for kids
item.description:
The little cloud lives above a sun-parched valley and stretches herself thin to shade a single sunflower, until her tiny tears become a night of rain. This gentle kids story about clouds uses warm, painterly skies to calm little dreamers and the grown-ups reading with them.
🌙 Moonbrim — moonbrim.com | @moonbrimstories
